title.zh: Charles Hoskinson称Cardano不再优先——其国库投票说明了原因
title.en: Charles Hoskinson says Cardano no longer comes first – its treasury vote explains why

current_state.zh: Cardano的DRep代表让Input Output为Pogun提出的1229万ADA国库请求到期而未获批准；Koios摘要显示DRep投票权64.33%反对、35.67%赞成，宪法委员会则记录七票赞成（100%委员会批准）。Charles Hoskinson在2026年9月18日广播中称Input Output将按技术和商业契合度选择网络、不再自动优先Cardano，但称Pogun仍将登陆Cardano；该提案曾提议返还20%收益直至偿付、之后对Cardano相关产品永久返还5%，正式提案将偿付与295万美元挂钩，相关日期仍属前瞻性目标。
current_state.en: Cardano DReps let Input Output's 12.29 million ADA treasury request for Pogun expire without ratification; Koios recorded 64.33% of delegated representative voting power against and 35.67% in favor, while the Constitutional Committee recorded seven yes votes (100% committee approval). In a Sept. 18, 2026 broadcast, Charles Hoskinson said Input Output will choose the best network for each product rather than automatically prioritizing Cardano, while saying Pogun is still headed to Cardano; the proposal had offered 20% of earnings until repayment, then a perpetual 5% on Cardano-related products, with repayment tied to $2.95 million, and stated dates remain forward-looking targets.
